manifest.name: dsh-theme-rhine-lab
manifest.description: Arknights Rhine Lab archive-terminal reconstruction for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with reversible deep styling and restrained institutional HUD

bundle.text:
# dsh-theme-rhine-lab bundle layer. Composition order is dsh-base →
# dsh-web-app → this bundle, so this layer may override the shipped rows.
# The inserted row is a dual-face dsh.client entry: its node half registers
# the durable preference namespace (ui-theme-rhine-lab) with the settings
# service, and its browser half applies the Rhine Lab skin.
#
# The first entry defensively disables the identical in-tree row
# (`ui-theme-rhine-lab`) that ships with source checkouts of the harness at
# 0.1.0-rc.5 — on a stock install that id does not exist and this entry is a
# harmless no-op warning. The settings namespace stays the same either way,
# so a preference written under one row survives a switch to the other.
- id: ui-theme-rhine-lab
  disabled: true

- insert:
    - id: rhine-lab-theme
      name: dsh-theme-rhine-lab

readme.text:
莱茵生命主题｜将 DeepSeek Harness 重组为研究档案终端

English · 简体中文

这是一个面向 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web 界面的《明日方舟》莱茵生命主题插件。它把对话工作区呈现为研究档案终端，同时保留 Harness 原有的控件、布局和设置流程。

- 以暖纸、浓墨和研究橙构成浅色总部档案模式。
- 以炭黑和青色实时状态构成深色夜间行动模式。
- 在 **设置 → 通用** 中用原生开关启用或关闭主题。
- 尊重减少动态效果偏好，并在窄屏隐藏非必要装饰。

**环境要求：** 已安装 DeepSeek Harness，并使用 Web profile。以下命令从 GitHub 获取当前默认分支版本：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ReLuckyLucy/dsh-Rhine-Lab-theme
```

安装后重启 `dsh web` 并刷新浏览器，再到 **设置 → 通用** 启用莱茵生命主题。要从源码运行或开发：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ReLuckyLucy/dsh-Rhine-Lab-theme.git
cd dsh-Rhine-Lab-theme
pnpm install
pnpm build

Git 安装直接使用仓库内已提交的 `lib/` 产物，不要求目标 profile 放行安装脚本；生成 npm tarball 时，`prepack` 会先重建产物。

本主题不读取用户数据集，也不需要下载模型或外部图片。它通过 DeepSeek Harness 提供的 Web 插件接口和主题令牌工作，源码中的 CSS 只作用于 Harness 页面锚点。主题偏好保存在 `ui-theme-rhine-lab.enabled`；浅色、深色或跟随系统的底色仍由 Harness 控制。

兼容性目标为 **DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0-rc.5 Web**。遇到未提供的页面锚点时，对应装饰会自然不生效，宿主控件和布局仍由 Harness 管理。

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test
pnpm build
npm pack --dry-run

生成可安装 tarball：

```sh
pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-theme-rhine-lab-0.2.1.tgz
```

制作版本化源码 ZIP（需先提交包含 `VERSION` 的提交）：

```sh
python scripts/package_source.py
```

ZIP 会写入 `artifacts/`，只包含该 Git 提交中已跟踪的文件。每次推送的源码 ZIP 也会作为 GitHub Actions Artifact 保留 30 天；推送与 `VERSION` 一致的 `v` 标签后，ZIP 会附加到 GitHub Release。
以下截图来自本项目真实运行的主题界面：

```text
dsh-Rhine-Lab-theme/
├── .github/workflows/archive.yml  # 推送归档与版本 Release
├── img/                           # README 标识
├── lib/                           # 已提交的运行构建产物
归档版本号以 [`VERSION`](VERSION) 为准，并与 `package.json` 对齐。推送提交会生成 `dsh-Rhine-Lab-theme-v版本号-提交短号.zip`。推送匹配的 `v版本号` 标签时，GitHub Actions 会创建长期 Release 并附上同一源码 ZIP。归档不包含未提交文件、`node_modules` 或运行环境。
代码采用 [MIT License](LICENSE)。本项目是非官方粉丝主题；《明日方舟》及莱茵生命相关名称和标识归鹰角网络 / Yostar 及其权利方所有。本项目不代表或隶属于权利方。

Rhine Lab Theme for DeepSeek Harness

简体中文 · English

An Arknights Rhine Lab theme for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web interface. It presents the conversation workspace as a research archive terminal while preserving Harness controls, layout, and settings flow.

- Warm paper, dense ink, and research orange for the light headquarters archive.
- Charcoal surfaces and cyan live-state accents for dark night operations.
- A native toggle in **Settings → General** to enable or disable the theme.
- Reduced nonessential decoration on narrow screens and support for reduced-motion preferences.

**Requirements:** DeepSeek Harness installed with the Web profile available. This installs the current default branch from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ReLuckyLucy/dsh-Rhine-Lab-theme
```

Restart `dsh web`, refresh the browser, then enable Rhine Lab in **Settings → General**. To build and install from source:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ReLuckyLucy/dsh-Rhine-Lab-theme.git
cd dsh-Rhine-Lab-theme
pnpm install
pnpm build
Git installs use the committed `lib/` artifacts and do not require lifecycle-script approval in the target profile. `prepack` rebuilds the artifacts before an npm tarball is produced.

The theme does not read user datasets or download models and external images. It uses the DeepSeek Harness Web plugin interface and theme tokens; its CSS is scoped to Harness page anchors. The preference is stored as `ui-theme-rhine-lab.enabled`. Harness continues to control the underlying Light, Dark, or System mode.
The compatibility target is **DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0-rc.5 Web**. If a page anchor is unavailable, only its decoration is omitted; Harness remains responsible for its own controls and layout.

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test
pnpm build
npm pack --dry-run

Create an installable tarball:

```sh
pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-theme-rhine-lab-0.2.1.tgz
```

Create a versioned source ZIP (the `VERSION` file must be present in the committed `HEAD`):

```sh
python scripts/package_source.py
```

The ZIP is written to `artifacts/` and contains only tracked files from that Git commit. Each push also uploads a GitHub Actions Artifact retained for 30 days. Pushing a `v` tag matching `VERSION` attaches the same source ZIP to a GitHub Release.
These screenshots show the theme running in the project’s actual test interface:

```text
dsh-Rhine-Lab-theme/
├── .github/workflows/archive.yml  # Push archives and version Releases
├── img/                           # README mark
├── lib/                           # Committed runtime build

[`VERSION`](VERSION) is the archive version source and must match `package.json`. A push creates `dsh-Rhine-Lab-theme-vVERSION-SHORTSHA.zip`. Pushing the matching `vVERSION` tag creates a long-term GitHub Release with the same ZIP attached. Archives exclude uncommitted files, `node_modules`, and runtime environments.

The code is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). This is an unofficial fan-made theme. Arknights and Rhine Lab names and marks belong to Hypergryph / Yostar and their respective rights holders; this project is not affiliated with them.
